league_wrap.title: Camp Desk — Tuesday, Sep 1
league_wrap.bottom_line: Waiver and IR day, not a 32-card dump. Named IR and named jobs matter. Existing LAC Under 2/5 stands. Everything else Pass.
storylines: Commanders: Club reversed Sunday — Tunsil and Newton are IR after Amos/McNichols took the cutdown DTR slots. Moreau and Tuttle signed back. Coleman remains the LT plan, not a crowned Week 1.
Cowboys: Howell is the named QB2 after Milton was waived for Demercado. Steele vs Broderick Jones at RT; Jones stays right; Guyton locked LT. Pass on crowning a tackle.
Bears: Bryant and Large to IR; Lynch and Sanborn signed. Dexter–Phillips still pending physicals. Gordon, Noah Sewell, and Shemar Turner remain PUP.

49ers: Bosa DNP Monday open; Kittle on an individual ramp. Shanahan wants both in team drills across three practices before Wednesday’s Australia departure — Kittle could stay home. Hobbs (groin) and Martin (hamstring) IR; Davis and Waitman re-signed; Patterson in from Houston for a 2027 seventh.
Chargers: Perryman IR-return (≥4) on top of Biadasz season IR. The ILB spot next to Henley is vacant — Harbaugh did not name it. Monday’s Under 2/5 stamp stands; Pass on a new number.
Dolphins: Seven claims plus FA Herring, with a corresponding 53 purge. Cook is a roster QB, not a starter. Do not crown EDGE1 or WR.
Patriots: Claimed Latu and Muasau; released Britt and Brown; IR for Baringer and Khalil Jacobs. Wishnowsky is PS punter insurance, not a crowned starter.
Jets: Grupe and Wallace awarded; Sanders released then to the PS; Levao waived; Meredith in (2027 seventh from LV for a 2027 sixth). Grupe is the 53 kicker — do not invent an OL starter.
league_wrap.what_to_watch: Named IR language that sticks, who actually dresses Week 1 after claims settle, 49ers Tue–Wed team drills before Australia, and whether anyone next to Henley gets a club naming. LAC Under 2/5 and DEN Over 2/5 stand — no chase.
